_note: v2 POROSITY-gradient demo — graded wallParam (denser core → more porous rim): the founder-opened 'softer rim at the living-tissue interface' option (HW.33), inverting the medical cortical-outside norm. Constant period. Porosity is MEASURED per shell (monotone here, vs flat for the cell-size SKUs); constant-vs-graded porosity is FEA-gated. Numbers illustrate the axis, not a validated spec. Topology NETWORK (⚖️ founder 2026-09-10, HW.33); the wall params are RE-SOLVED for network, where the param is a LEVEL, not a band — the pair is solved against the SHEET SHELL PROFILE, not against uniform end-points, so the port reproduces it exactly — measured 61/63/67/70/73 % core→rim at 68.3 % overall, the same two numbers the sheet version read. Sub-floor metal fell 12.5 % -> 0.4 % on the way. The NEGATIVE rim value is the reason gyroid_wall_param_rim is nullable rather than `> 0`-sentinelled: the old sentinel would have collapsed this gradient to constant silently.
name: anchor_zone1_graded_porosity

notes.material: V-free Ti alloy (01_02 2.5, founder 2026-06-21) - the SPECIFIC alloy is NOT selected until the Stage-2 coin bake-off (00_07 HW.24); Ti-6Al-4V is the price and print baseline only, NOT the material of this part
notes.process: SLM/LPBF MANDATORY for Zone 1 - NOT EBM, and the powder fraction is the reason: 15-45 um resolves the lattice where EBM 45-105 um risks plugging fine pores (01_02 1.7) | HIP obligatory 920C/100-150 MPa Ar/2-4 h, then vacuum anneal 800C/2 h (01_02 1.3 Step 2, 1.7) | build direction PARALLEL to the long axis, 0 +/-5 deg, externally-only supports (01_02 1.6) | de-powdering is CHEMICAL: vacuum decanting + citric/Tween circulation (1.3 Step 3). NO Al2O3 sand-blasting and NO static-tank etching on this part - both are canon-forbidden for Zone 1 specifically, unlike the Zone-3 flange (01_02 1.3a Failure Modes A and B)
notes.post_process: EAAE with forced flow-through + ultrasonic cavitation (01_02 1.3 Step 4), then dehydrogenation bake 250C/10-3 mbar/3h within 2h of rinse - MANDATORY, and HIP does NOT substitute for it: hydrogen enters AFTER HIP, at the EAAE stage (01_02 1.3a Failure Mode C). LECO RH404 H<100 ppm per batch or the batch is rejected
notes.surface_finish: EAAE dual-scale on the gyroid walls: micro Sa 0.5-5 um + nano Sv 50-500 nm, BET area >10x a smooth sample (01_02 1.2). NO PEP smoothing on this part - the plasma sheath is Faraday-caged in sub-500 um channels and PEP belongs to the Zone-3 outer jacket only (01_02 1.3 Step 7)
notes.coating_restriction: Gyroid walls in xylem-sap contact (the anode active surface): ZnO-Ta, self-healing 8-HQ and biomimetic (Zn-HAp/chitosan) ALL FORBIDDEN - any dielectric blocks DET, and canon forbids ZnO-Ta on Zone-1 gyroid walls outright (01_02 3.6). Bare Ti with the dual-scale roughness only; the Gen 2.0 bio-electrochemical stack is applied by us downstream, cold (01_03 2.1). The Zone-1 PERIPHERY in callus contact, carrying no immobilised enzymes, is a DIFFERENT row of the same map (Zn-HAp + chitosan allowed, ZnO-Ta only outside the enzyme zone - 01_02 3.6, 01_04 4). WHERE that boundary runs is not a field of this manifest and has NO carrier today: draw anchor_zone1 is unimplemented (00_07 HW.1), so nothing conveys it to a shop - do not infer it from the geometry
notes.lattice_spec: Gyroid, NETWORK topology (ratified founder 2026-09-10, 00_07 HW.33) - ONE through pore labyrinth by construction. This SKU grades the POROSITY through the wall level at CONSTANT period (the opposite axis from the species SKUs, which grade the cell period): denser core, more porous rim - the founder-opened softer-rim-at-the-living-tissue option. The rim level is NEGATIVE, which on network is an ORDINARY level and not an error; on the retired sheet formulation it would have been meaningless, which is why the rim field is nullable rather than sentinelled. Constant-vs-graded porosity is itself FEA-gated (00_07 HW.33). Porosity, and read this BEFORE rejecting a shell: this SKU is graded BY CONSTRUCTION, so its per-shell values span WIDER than the 60-70% factory band of 01_02 1.2 while its overall value sits inside it - 01_01 5.2 states in as many words that this SKU does not fall in the measured band of the species SKUs, neither by design nor by measurement. Whether a band judges the shell or the whole on a graded part is NOT settled in canon (00_07 HW.33): do not reject a shell reading outside the band without asking. The other canon numbers, for reference: nominal 65% (01_01 5.2), verification 65 +/-2% (01_01 5.6). Verify per shell, by Archimedes open porosity + uCT connectivity (01_02 1.2)
notes.inspection: SEM before shipment at x500 (gyroid macro-pores), x5,000 (micro-roughness: report the AREAL Sa of the 01_02 1.2 acceptance row, not a profile Ra) and x50,000 (nano-pores Sv) - all three frames apply to THIS part because it has the macro-pore geometry the x500 frame is for; if nano-pores are not visible at x50,000 the etch is insufficient and EAAE is repeated (01_02 1.5). uCT pore-gradient verification in the PRINTED range (targets set by 00_07 HW.33, not by this line). Archimedes open porosity. LECO RH404 H<100 ppm per batch or rejected. ICP-MS of the rinse water, Al<1 ppb - confirms no corundum residue (01_02 1.2, 1.5)
extra: Zone 1 = the buried anode: gyroid walls in xylem sap (01_01 1)
The monolithic bus rod (01_01 1.4) is this part's own solid core when bus_rod_diameter_mm > 0; it is SDF-invisible, so the porosity and connectivity gates measure the gyroid annulus, not the rod

slm_min_wall_mm is a VENDOR input (ratified 2026-09-10): absent means the canon 200 um default of 01_01 5.5 (a DEFAULT, not a constant - and a different quantity from the 0.3 mm gyroid wall floor of 01_02 1.7), and the same number also sets the measurement grid - a finer vendor floor costs about an order of magnitude more run time
NO factory drawing exists for this part yet (draw anchor_zone1 unimplemented, 00_07 HW.1): these notes are the SOURCE of the acceptance contract, not yet its carrier
